minimum_actions: Operator supplies jurisdiction, entity/person classification, and intended account/access class (UNK-0034).
Operator selects one branch and authorizes the minimum vendor/exchange/broker data request; no purchase is authorized by this goal.
For the selected branch, obtain a sample/quote or documented free historical source sufficient to validate timestamps, instrument identity, and causal replay.
external_block.highest_value_missing_evidence: A decision-ready owned/free historical sample plus exact account-level all-in cost for one candidate branch; without both, no after-friction empirical result can change scheduling.
external_block.successor_goal: After operator/account and data-access facts are supplied, select exactly one branch and preregister the cheapest gross-magnitude-versus-friction falsifier before any queue or strategy model is built.

prohibited_inference: No missing fee, fill, latency, or data values imputed
